headlines: Telecoms plunge: T -10%, VZ -9.6%, TMUS -12% on heavy volume; web reports tie recent carrier weakness to SpaceX spectrum/mobile-service push
ASTS -14.5%, GRRR -11.5%, JOBY -8% lead Stocktwits trending; GME +4%, PLTR +3.4%, SNAP +6%
No major US data today; Canada unemployment 6.5% vs 6.4%

rumors.text: Telecom selloff (T, VZ, TMUS) is driven by SpaceX spectrum/direct-to-cell ambitions to compete as a carrier; posters call it an overreaction
rumors.why: If SpaceX builds a consumer network, carriers lose pricing power and subscribers

rumors.text: Posters expect SPY to reach 780 within hours; others call a bear flag and breakdown
rumors.why: Crowd split; 780 is a round-number magnet only 0.4% away

rumors.text: Oil turning lower could let the market pop
rumors.why: Falling oil eases inflation worries and helps risk appetite

plays.reason: Steady grind higher, QQQ and IWM green, VIX 15, fear/greed 44 with no scheduled catalysts; long-weekend fade risk caps the edge

readings.whats_new: SPY rose to about 777 (+0.41%) from 776 last hour, VIX eased to 15.06 and fear and greed improved to 44 from 38. Telecom losses deepened (TMUS -12%, T -10%, VZ -9.6%) and web reports now link the pressure to SpaceX spectrum and mobile-service ambitions, though today's cause is still unconfirmed. Gold is up 1.45% and Stocktwits chatter stays split between 780 targets and bear-flag calls.

note: Derived from live readings: net +1 votes (needs ±2) → neutral.
